title: 第19章 九锻雷锁经万象真阳根本经第20章 联姻
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
隐龙城巡夜司，全灭！
夜洐来到宝物室外。
门口白骨夫人难掩喜色：“大人，宝物不少，疗伤药物足够让我们四人恢复巅峰，只可惜可供魔道经法修炼的宝物稀缺。”
夜洐迈入宝物室中。
木架上，摆放众多玉匣，玉匣中摆放奇花异草，散发宝光，弥漫独有草木精华之气。
案上陈列着许多形态各异的玉瓶，都是成品丹药，有疗伤秘药，提升修为的灵液。
任何一样，曾经都是夜洐梦寐以求的宝物。
夜洐来到最深处。
目光落在一个玉盒上。
内部散发温暖又炙热的生命阳气。
打开玉盒，一颗百年阳果，鲜红欲滴，蕴含磅礴的阳性物质。
已入异宝之列，是此地最珍贵的宝物之一，也是夜洐急需的阳性宝物。
夜洐又看向旁边一个玉瓶。
隐约传出雷鸣声。
打开玉瓶，其中流淌着湛蓝色的雷液，提炼春雷锻造而成的雷液，极其珍贵，不低于异宝。
夜洐把所有阳性与雷性物质的宝物，都收入囊中。
“能用则用，不能用都拿走。”
“是。”
有了命令，白骨夫人才走进宝物室中，寻找所需要的宝物。
性子最急躁的杀人寇，反倒没进去，而是提议道：“大人，隐龙城众多世家豪族，应该有不少好东西，不如我们把这些家族都给灭了，东西全抢过来，不能用以后也能换取其他宝物。”

杀人寇全然没把隐龙城其余势力放在眼中。
隐龙城最强大的巡夜司都已经被我们灭了。
其他世家豪族不值一提。
如果一开始隐龙城所有势力联合起来，还有机会，现在没了巡夜司。
在杀人寇眼中，整个隐龙城就是任人宰割，可以肆意妄为。
“对啊，那些家族百年积累，不知道有多少宝物。”血魔点头附议。
“闭嘴，你们冷静点。”白骨夫人跑出来忍不住训斥眼里只有杀杀杀的疯狗两人，低声提醒：“大人情况你们又不是不了解，你们想再次体会那种经历，本夫人可不想。”
杀人寇与血魔两人，疯癫充血的眼神，立刻清澈了。
一股寒意从脚底升起。
发自内心的畏惧看向夜洐，看到夜洐手背上有些裂开的痕迹，心底更慌了。
那不是在战斗受伤的痕迹。
而是传说中魔道祖庭法失控的迹象。
“别怕，没到那一步，姜无涯他没资格逼到我到那一步。”夜洐平静道，知道他们在怕什么。
content_en:
The Night Patrol Department of Hidden Dragon City was completely wiped out!
Ye Zhi came to the treasure room.
Mrs. Bones at the door couldn't hide her joy: "Sir, there are a lot of treasures. The healing medicine is enough to restore the four of us to our peak. It's a pity that the treasures for practicing magic scriptures are scarce."
Ye Hu stepped into the treasure room.
On the wooden shelf, there are many jade boxes, and the jade boxes are filled with exotic flowers and plants, which emit precious light and are filled with the unique essence of plants and trees.
There are many jade bottles of different shapes displayed on the table, all of which contain finished elixirs, secret healing elixirs, and spiritual fluids for improving cultivation.
Anything and everything was once a treasure that Ye Zhi dreamed of.
Ye Zhi came to the deepest part.
His eyes fell on a jade box.
The inside exudes warm and hot life yang energy.
Opening the jade box, you will find a century-old yang fruit, bright red and containing majestic yang substance.
It has been classified as a rare treasure. It is one of the most precious treasures here, and it is also a masculine treasure that Ye Qi urgently needs.
Ye Tao looked at the jade bottle next to him.
There was a faint sound of thunder.
Open the jade bottle, and there is a blue thunder liquid flowing in it. The thunder liquid forged by refining the spring thunder is extremely precious, no less than a rare treasure.
Ye Zhi has collected all the treasures of masculine and thunderous substances in his bag.
"Use it if you can, take it away if you can't."
"Yes."
With the order, Madam Bones walked into the treasure room to look for the needed treasures.
The most impatient murderer did not go in, but suggested: "Sir, there should be a lot of good things from the many wealthy families in Hidden Dragon City. Why don't we kill all these families and grab all the things that can't be used in exchange for other treasures later."
The murderer didn't pay any attention to the other forces in Hidden Dragon City.
The most powerful night watch department in Hidden Dragon City has been destroyed by us.
Other wealthy families are not worth mentioning.
If all the forces in Hidden Dragon City united at the beginning, there would still be a chance, but now there is no Night Watch Division.
In the eyes of the murderer, the entire Hidden Dragon City is at the mercy of others and can do whatever they want.
"Yes, those families have accumulated hundreds of years of treasures. I don't know how many treasures there are." Gorefiend nodded in agreement.
"Shut up, calm down." Madam Bones ran out and couldn't help scolding the two mad dogs who only had eyes for killing and killing, and reminded in a low voice: "It's not like you don't understand the situation, sir. If you want to experience that kind of experience again, I don't want it."
The crazy and bloodshot eyes of the murderer and the blood demon immediately became clear.
A chill rose from the soles of my feet.
He looked at Ye Hao with fear from the bottom of his heart, and saw some crack marks on the back of Ye Hao's hands, which made him even more panicked.
It was not the mark of a battle injury.
It was a sign that the legendary Demonic Ancestral Court Law was out of control.
"Don't be afraid. I haven't reached that point yet. Jiang Wuya has no right to force me to that point." Ye Tao said calmly, knowing what they were afraid of.
